notes:
Literally means to suck in or draw in. Used both for physical suction (vacuums, medical aspiration) and figuratively for attracting people or attention.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {吸引|きゅういん}{力|りょく}: suction power; drawing power
- {吸引|きゅういん}{器|き}: suction device, aspirator
- ⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧{吸引|きゅういん}: liposuction
- ⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧{吸引|きゅういん}: population attraction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{吸収|きゅうしゅう}→吸収：02608_kyuushuu⟧: absorption — takes something in and integrates it, rather than merely drawing it in
- ⟦{誘引|ゆういん}→誘引：22537_yuuin⟧: attraction, luring — emphasizes enticement or inducement
- ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧: charm, appeal — describes the quality itself rather than the act of drawing in
